text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. In response to a request from Councillor Paul Ainslie and a neighbourhood petition, Transportation Services staff reviewed the need for traffic calming, specifically the installation of speed humps on Keeler Boulevard, between Neilson Road and David Drive. Our assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the Traffic Calming Policy has not been satisfied. Therefore, traffic calming should not be installed on the subject section of Keeler Boulevard.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Waived the petition and polling requirements under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorize the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Keeler Boulevard, between Neilson Road and David Drive. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway for the installation of speed humps on Keeler Boulevard, between Neilson Road and David Drive, generally as shown on the Location Map attached as Attachment 1 to this report entitled "Traffic Calming (Speed Humps) Review - Keeler Boulevard, between Neilson Road and David Drive". 3. Reduced the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Keeler Boulevard, between Neilson Road and David Drive, in conjunction with the installation of speed humps.
